title: 新加坡部长甘金勇谈信任与合作
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: How much is engagement with China part of this because often I mean a lot some of the certainly many of the sectors we're talking about it's not a general wish to be self sufficient or diversify it's a specific wish to not be dependent on China.
segments.zh: 与中国的接触在多大程度上是其中一部分？因为我们谈论的许多领域，并非普遍希望自给自足或多元化，而是具体希望不依赖中国。

segments.en: So how much is this if it's a China policy how much does engagement with China what's the role that that should play I mean we've seen recently in a different context.
segments.zh: 那么，如果这是对华政策，与中国的接触应扮演什么角色？我们最近在另一个背景下看到。

segments.en: Europe has achieved the voluntary export quotas from China just as the US had achieved with Japan in the 1980s is that kind of engagement China part of that to provide space for domestic industry.
segments.zh: 欧洲已从中国获得自愿出口配额，正如美国在1980年代与日本达成的那样。这种与中国的接触是否为国内产业提供空间？

segments.en: I think it's important for countries in the world to continue to engage with one another even as the world has become increasingly fragmented all the more important for countries to find ways to work with one another.
segments.zh: 我认为，即使世界日益碎片化，各国继续相互接触也很重要，更重要的是找到合作方式。

segments.en: Maybe perhaps in very specific areas whether it's Singapore whether it's ASEAN whether it's China EU or US I think very few of us can be totally independent of the others so there must be ways for us to look towards working together and that trust is a very important element.
segments.zh: 或许在非常具体的领域，无论是新加坡、东盟、中国、欧盟还是美国，我们中很少有人能完全独立于他人，因此必须寻求合作，而信任是非常重要的元素。

segments.en: We work with like-minded countries that we can trust that we can work together they are dependable they're reliable and that's why we form free trade agreements we form groupings among ourselves to work with one another like in Singapore and Canada we also have a free trade agreement we are also looking at how we can strengthen our collaboration through our economic collaboration partnership.
segments.zh: 我们与可信赖的志同道合国家合作，它们可靠且值得依赖，这就是我们形成自由贸易协定和 groupings 的原因。像新加坡和加拿大也有自由贸易协定，我们也在研究如何通过经济合作夥伴关系加强协作。
